nodes.label: Express Middleware Chain Pattern
nodes.rationale: errorHandler must be registered last in Express middleware chain to catch errors from all prior handlers; notFound is registered before it to handle unmatched routes

nodes.label: npm Workspaces Definition
nodes.rationale: npm Workspaces chosen over Lerna and polyrepo for native npm support, simplified tooling, shared dependencies, and no external tool overhead.

nodes.label: TypeScript Strict Mode
nodes.rationale: strict:true enforces safer TypeScript patterns; noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters catch dead code early; supports ADR-002 TypeScript Strict Mode decision.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern (data access abstraction)
nodes.rationale: Repository pattern mandated to prevent raw SQL in services, enforce parameterized queries, and decouple data access from business logic.

nodes.label: IPC Security via contextBridge (Electron)
nodes.rationale: contextBridge required instead of nodeIntegration:true to limit renderer access to Node.js APIs and prevent security vulnerabilities in Electron apps.

nodes.label: AAA Test Pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert)
nodes.rationale: AAA pattern enforced for consistent, readable test structure across all workspaces. Required naming: 'should <behavior> when <condition>'.

nodes.label: Define Once Use Everywhere (shared types principle)
nodes.rationale: All cross-workspace types live in shared/ to avoid type duplication and ensure a single source of truth for interfaces like IUser, IApiResponse, IAuthPayload.

nodes.label: ADR-001: npm Workspaces Monorepo
nodes.rationale: Chose npm Workspaces over Lerna and Yarn/pnpm because it provides native npm support without extra tooling overhead. Polyrepo rejected due to code reuse difficulty. Lerna rejected as overkill. Yarn/pnpm rejected because npm is standard and no compelling reason to switch.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Three-stage pipeline: lint-and-typecheck → build → package. Package job runs only on main branch and produces .vsix artifact retained 30 days.

nodes.label: VS Code FileDecorationProvider Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses VS Code's FileDecorationProvider API to overlay badge icons and colors onto file explorer entries without modifying the file tree structure.

nodes.label: Jest coverage-summary.json Format
nodes.rationale: Jest json-summary reporter outputs an object keyed by absolute file paths with lines/functions/statements/branches metrics. Special case: 'total' key holds aggregate.

nodes.label: Windows Drive Letter Case Normalization
nodes.rationale: vscode.Uri.fsPath returns lowercase drive letter on Windows (c:\...) while Jest uses uppercase (C:\...). getFileCoverage tries both forms to avoid missed lookups.

nodes.label: Coverage Threshold Pass/Fail Logic
nodes.rationale: Default threshold of 75%. Files with avg pct >= threshold get green bullet, below threshold or in failedFiles set get red X, no data gets grey circle.
